parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal plywood shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet space into sections.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or sometimes adjustable but generally non-moving during use.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage space for organizing items.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary or can be repositioned if adjustable.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: A central shelf within the cabinet structure.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet vertically for better organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not designed for frequent movement.

parts.name: Shelf 4
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports lighter items stored near the top of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 5
parts.Basic_description: A topmost shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the highest storage level for less frequently accessed items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 1
parts.Basic_description: A hinged MDF door located on the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the contents of the upper compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 2
parts.Basic_description: A hinged MDF door located on the middle section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the middle storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 3
parts.Basic_description: A hinged MDF door located on the lower section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the lower storage area and is frequently accessed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 4
parts.Basic_description: A hinged MDF door located on the bottom-most section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lowest compartment for storage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.
